# German Real Estate Foreclosures (ZVG-Portal) Sample Dataset

[![Apify Actor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Apify-ZVG%20Scraper-FF7626?logo=apify&logoColor=white)](https://apify.com/AGrunert/german-real-estate-foreclosure-zvg-scraper)
[![GitHub Suite](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-German%20B2B%20Suite-blue?logo=github)](https://github.com/andregrunert-ctrl/german-b2b-data-suite)

A weekly-refreshed curated sample of active, upcoming judicial real estate foreclosure auctions (*Zwangsversteigerungen*) across Germany, extracted directly from the official joint portal of the German federal state judiciaries (`zvg-portal.de`).

---

## Overview & Scope

- **Source:** Official German Judiciary Foreclosure Portal (`www.zvg-portal.de`) & Local District Courts (*Amtsgerichte*).
- **Scope:** Up to 50 active, upcoming real estate foreclosure proceedings distributed across German federal states (*Bayern, NRW, Berlin, Baden-Württemberg, Hessen, Sachsen, etc.*).
- **Format:** Strict RFC 4180 CSV (comma-delimited `,`, dot decimal `.`, `snake_case` headers) ready for `pandas.read_csv()` and Kaggle Kernels, plus JSON & styled Excel workbook (`.xlsx`).
- **Quality Standard:** All listings contain judicial market valuations in EUR (`market_value_eur` as positive float), structured addresses, future auction dates, and 1-click links to official court appraisals (*Gutachten*).

---

## How to Access & Download PDF Appraisals

The official justice portal (`zvg-portal.de`) blocks direct external hotlinks without a portal referer.

### Programmatic Download (Python)
Pass `detail_url` as the `Referer` header:

```python
import httpx

headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)",
    "Referer": item["detail_url"],
}

response = httpx.get(item["pdf_primary_url"], headers=headers)
if response.status_code == 200 and response.content.startswith(b"%PDF"):
    with open(f"gutachten_{item['zvg_id']}.pdf", "wb") as f:
        f.write(response.content)
```

### 1-Click Excel Gateway
All hyperlinks in `DE_Zwangsversteigerungen_Sample_50.xlsx` use our automated **1-Click POST Gateway** (`https://andregrunert-ctrl.github.io/german-b2b-data-suite/zvg.html`), which automatically opens the official proceeding on `zvg-portal.de` so PDFs open reliably in one click.
